build_effnet_model: build an EfficientNet model with stem, stages, and head for image classification
create_mbconv_block: create a Mobile inverted bottleneck block with SE attention and skip connections
create_effstage_module: create an EfficientNet stage with multiple MBConv blocks stacked sequentially
create_effhead_module: create an EfficientNet classification head with 1x1 conv, avg pool, dropout, and FC layer
compute_effnet_complexity: compute the model complexity of an EfficientNet given its architecture parameters
